verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Shopify POS can take payments on hardware: Tap to Pay turns an iOS/Android phone into a contactless checkout, and POS Hub connects peripherals to a tablet over USB. However, nothing documents pairing a dedicated card reader with the app or registering one to an account, and nothing describes a quick setup time. Missing for 10: documented card-reader pairing/registration flow, evidence of setup-to-first-payment within minutes, hands-on corroboration.
